entities.summary: Charles Yuji Horioka is a Japanese-American economist residing in Japan. Horioka received his B.A. and Ph.D. degrees from Harvard University and is currently Research Professor at the Center for Computational Social Science and Research Fellow at the Research Institute for Economics and Business Administration, Kobe University, Kobe, Japan. He is concurrently Distinguished Research Professor and Director at the Asian Growth Research Institute and Invited Professor and Professor Emeritus at the Institute of Social and Economic Research, Osaka University.
